messages:
anne: Quick sync — changelog cutoff is EOD tomorrow. Need a single-line status from owners: SDKs, docs, sample apps, quickstarts. Call out any blockers (PR reviews, model-map change, CI flakes). I want to lock the changelog and tag the release by 17:00 PT.

mike: SDKs: all PRs merged except iOS auth patch (MR #412). I'm waiting on one review from @jordan. No functional changes, just token refresh tests failing on CI. Working on patch. ETA EOD.

jordan: On it, will review iOS auth in next 30m. Heads up: the token refresh tests are flaky locally for me too, might be environment. If mike sees the same, may merge with a flaky-test skip and a followup.

leah: Docs: PRs for quickstart and auth guide are ready — docs PR 258. Need final wording on the streaming example (Sam, can you confirm the chunking note?). Otherwise I can cut the changelog entries.

sam: Confirmed — streaming chunking note: "use stream=true and a 512 token buffer to avoid partial JSON frames". I'll paste a minimal snippet below.

sam: ```js
const resp = await client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'oas-v1', prompt, stream: true });
for await (const part of resp) { processChunk(part); }
```

sam: Also flagging that sample app A uses the older `chat.create` call; I have a followup PR to update to the new shape, but it depends on dev-api change `rename:messages->items` (blocked by eng-runtime).

tyler: eng-runtime: the rename is scheduled but gating on a small schema migration in the router. Migration review is in my queue, aiming to get it merged by tomorrow morning. If it lands before noon PT, sample app update should be fine for the release.

mike: Noted — if the API change slips, I can keep the SDK backward compat shim for one release and mark the changelog. Prefer to avoid shims but can do it.

jordan: Quickstarts: all examples updated except the Dockerized sampleapp (leah? or sam?) — image build is failing due to a missing env var in CI: SAMPLE_API_KEY. I think that's a secrets scoping issue in the new org runners.

leah: That's in infra. I'll ping infra and add an entry to the release blocker board. If infra can't fix by EOD, we should remove the Docker sample from the changelog and mark it as in-progress.

devex-bot: ci/circleci:build 278 passed for repo sample-apps (main). :white_check_mark:

anne: Thanks all. Action items I'm tracking: 1) @jordan review iOS auth today, 2) @tyler land schema migration by noon PT if possible, 3) @leah confirm Docker runner secret status, 4) @mike prepare shim PR if rename slips, 5) @sam push sample app API update PR once router migration lands.

anne: If we don't hit all of the above, plan B is to cut changelog without Docker sample and call out the sample-app API update in "Known Issues" with an install-time note. Please post single-line status updates here as you make progress so I can update the changelog before tagging. :thumbsup:
